name: Block issuance when RP access certificate verification fails

methodName: Block issuance when RP access certificate verification fails

testSteps.description: Given an issuance flow has been initiated by a Relying Party
When the Wallet processes the RP Access Certificate
Then the Wallet terminates the issuance interaction
And the Wallet displays a notification informs the Wallet user that the issuance has been blocked indicating that the RP could not be verified
And the Wallet displays a clear notification to the Wallet user that no information about the Wallet user has been shared

userStory.storyName: RP Access Certificate verification failure in issuance flow
userStory.displayName: RP Access Certificate verification failure in issuance flow
userStory.narrative:
As an EUDI Wallet User,
  I want the Wallet to notify me whenever the processing of a Wallet Relying Party Access Certificate fails in the issuance flow
  so that I can avoid sharing my information with an untrusted party.

title: Block issuance when RP access certificate verification fails
